questions.stem: What is the sum of (3 + 4i) and (-1 - 2i)?
questions.explanation: When adding complex numbers, you add the real parts and the imaginary parts separately.
questions.common_mistake_notes: A common mistake is to not separate the real and imaginary parts correctly. For example, adding the real parts together and the imaginary parts together would result in (2 + 2i), which is choice C.

questions.explanation: Remember to add the real parts and the imaginary parts separately.
questions.common_mistake_notes: A common mistake is to mix up the signs when adding the real parts or the imaginary parts. For example, if you mistakenly added -4 and 7 as -11 instead of +3, you would get (3 - 11i), which is not one of the choices.

questions.stem: What is the result of adding (2 + 3i) and (-2 + 5i)?
questions.explanation: When adding complex numbers, combine like terms: the real parts and the imaginary parts.
questions.common_mistake_notes: A common mistake is to not distribute the addition across both parts of each complex number. For example, if you added (2 + -2) as 0 and (3i + 5i) as 8i separately, you might mistakenly conclude that the sum is (0 + 8i), which would be choice A.

questions.explanation: Add the real parts and the imaginary parts separately, paying attention to their signs.
questions.common_mistake_notes: A common mistake is to add the real parts with the same sign and the imaginary parts with the opposite sign. For example, if you added 6 and -3 as 3 and -7i and 4i as -3i, you would get (3 - 3i), which is choice A.

questions.stem: What is the sum of (8 + 2i) and (-6 - 9i)?
questions.explanation: When adding complex numbers, combine like terms: the real parts and the imaginary parts.
questions.common_mistake_notes: A common mistake is to add the real parts with different signs incorrectly. For example, if you added 8 and -6 as -4 instead of +2, you would get (2 - 7i), which is choice B.

questions.explanation: Add the real parts and the imaginary parts separately, considering their signs.
questions.common_mistake_notes: A common mistake is to add the real parts with different signs incorrectly or to combine the imaginary parts with the wrong sign. For example, if you added -5 and 9 as 4 and 3i and -4i as -1i, you would get (4 + 1i), which is choice C.

questions.stem: What is the sum of (7i) and (-3i)?
questions.explanation: When adding complex numbers with only imaginary parts, combine the coefficients of i.
questions.common_mistake_notes: A common mistake is to treat the imaginary parts as real numbers and add them together. For example, if you added 7 and -3 as 4, you would get (4i), which is choice A.
